rationale: Paris shooting raises EU security concerns; West Bank attack adds Middle East tension; Typhoon hits Taiwan with casualties.

top_events.title: Anti-terror police investigate as one person killed in shooting near Paris
top_events.label: Shooting near Paris kills one, terror probe
top_events.summary: Gun attack in Trappes near Paris kills one; French PM calls it very serious. Raises security concerns across western EU including Portugal.

top_events.title: Hundreds of flights cancelled as Typhoon Champi shuts Taiwan
top_events.label: Typhoon Champi shuts Taiwan, one dead
top_events.summary: Typhoon with 191 km/h winds hits Taiwan; one person swept away by waves. Distant natural disaster with no direct impact on Portugal.

top_events.title: Two Israeli soldiers killed in attack by suspected Palestinian gunmen in West Bank
top_events.label: Two Israeli soldiers killed in West Bank
top_events.summary: Palestinian gunmen kill two Israeli soldiers near Hebron days before election. Adds to Middle East tensions with minimal direct impact on Portugal.

short_summary: Storm kills four in southern France flooding

most_significant_event.label: Storm kills four in southern France flooding
most_significant_event.summary: Severe weather in neighboring France causes fatalities. Indirect reminder of climate risks in western Europe, minimal direct impact on Portuguese life.
most_significant_event.title: At least four dead after storm brings flooding to southern France
